namespace_policy: app.android_native_data.*, app.webview_data.*, app.web_data.*, browser.web_data.* are disjoint; never flatten App Web and Browser into one web_data mapping
pair_policy: Only P1 completed pairs with App and Browser receipt/session/payload bindings can provide Browser evidence. P2 loader verifies bindings before runtime. Arbitrary inline records are not receipt verification.
masking_policy: Choose input surfaces before reading field values/status/quality or Browser pair metadata. Missing/blocked dependencies => NOT_EVALUATED, source parse ambiguity => UNKNOWN, false implication antecedent/reduced OS token => NOT_APPLICABLE.

active_browser_relations.limitations: DST boundary or time/settings changes between captures
privacy caps and logical processor availability; 0 is sentinel
zoom, density and per-container window configuration
orientation normalized only; multiwindow and screen exposure can differ
Native field is App display metrics, not panel resolution; short side avoids orientation but not split windows/zoom
CSSOM screen exposure relation, not independent hardware evidence
Chrome Android >=107 reduced Android 10 token is compatible, not actual OS recovery; customized UA can still violate

exclusions: Do not activate P3 rejected/descriptive-only rules
No WebGL2 capability inference from shared-canvas probe
No threshold fitting, source data edits, labels or model calls
claim_boundary: Runtime observations do not classify attack/benign or validate detection performance.
